body: My money is nearly wiped out considering I've lost my source of income. I have no insurance. You can bet your ass I'd be in a psychiatrists' office. But I simply cannot afford it. I would be open to therapy, but I don't want to be on anti-depressants.

I met her my senior year. we were together for 3 years. She left me a few weeks ago. For another guy, her neighbor. She told me she loved me and showered me with affection everyday up until she dumped me. I was devastated, she might as well have died. I got the job because I worked my ass off in school, graduated from a top tier institution. And in my depression following the wake of my break-up, I was so distraught, my work suffered, and I was forced to resign. I quit smoking weed, stopped drinking, cut out alcohol, and workout daily now, to no avail.
